svg.title: Where VirtualPyTest uses AI, step by step
svg.text: Each use case, step by step. A badge marks the steps that ask a model.
20 of 40 steps ask a cloud model. 16 use no model.
a small model on the host CPU
No badge: a rule, a clock or a measurement. No model.
So a person only looks at real problems
A FREEZE, BLACK SCREEN OR NO AUDIO ALERT
pixel and sound measurements on the host
a frame judged harmless before: discarded, no model
reads the words on the first and last frame
a sure menu is discarded, in 0.25 ms
a vision model judges the rest: real or noise?
still screen by design or a real freeze?
a person only looks at the real ones
Failed runs caused by the lab are set aside
a failure already judged: no model, logged only
a small decision model, used when 0.9 sure or more
else the LLM reads the report, logs, screenshots
real app bug, or noise: lab network, device asleep
app failure, stale test or retry?
When the fingerprint is not sure
picture fingerprints compared with the stored screens
only on a doubtful match: a tie, low confidence
without a sure yes the answer becomes unknown
reads programme, times and number, in 0.3 s
the number gives the name, once two answers agree
a known logo gives the name
the AI reads a logo once, then never again
UNKNOWN SCREENS: A SCREEN LOCALIZE COULD NOT NAME
only then is a name asked for
accepts, merges or dismisses the proposed name
From plain words. No code, no Python.
reads a new app screen, when a crawl runs
plans the steps of a test from a goal
builds the script, test case or navigation tree
a virtual script, a test case or a tree
the result is checked by a person
Questions about the tool, a screen or a run
NOT A SEQUENCE: EACH ONE ANSWERS ON ITS OWN
questions about the docs; the Ask cache first
fleet chat and scheduled checks; asks first
a daily summary of the fleet
external AI tools, with their own model
NOT A SEQUENCE: EACH ONE RUNS ON ITS OWN
what is on: screen type, programme
re-reads a fixed crop: the score, the speaker name
a web search about the programme or a claim
best effort, else the source text is shown
People often think it is. No model at all.
the shortest path in the tree
AI only where nothing simpler can decide.
